note: Initial bounds for a SEPARATELY AUTHORIZED bounded production canary of the Eurostat TURKEY_HEALTH_BURDEN reader (DOSSIER_CANARY_V2). Nothing here was executed, enabled or deployed. Lease and CPU are initial contracts, not measured optima.

limits.SOURCE_REQUESTS_NOTE: one data request; a second request exists only as the single retry of a transient failure inside the run

enforced_mechanically_by.MAX_CONCURRENT_CONCEPT_PROPOSERS: canary.ts V2 lease statement: a lease is granted only if no other canary run holds an unexpired lease (single atomic UPDATE); plus the V2 lease-deadline stop
enforced_mechanically_by.D1_BUDGET: createBudgetedD1 hard statement guard + pause at unit boundaries
enforced_mechanically_by.NO_CT_REFETCH: profile validation (clinicaltrials is not a reader of V2) + SOURCE_NOT_IN_CANARY_PROFILE refusal
enforced_mechanically_by.OECD: profile validation (oecd must be OFF) + V2 registry contains only the Eurostat reader

hard_stop_criteria: any invocation records more than 400 D1 statements (half of the 800 ceiling) or hits the statement guard
any platform termination or exceededCpu / exceededResources outcome
an invocation runs longer than 30 s of wall time (two thirds of the 45 s lease)
more than one source request is observed outside a recorded transient retry
any source error class other than a single retried SOURCE_HTTP_ERROR / SOURCE_RATE_LIMIT
observations written exceed the 100 item cap or any non-Turkiye geography appears
any ClinicalTrials request, any ClinicalTrials row change, or OECD activity
a concept appears twice for one normalized label, or any concept becomes ACTIVE
a candidate, snapshot or review is created without an explicit human action (0 candidates is the expected outcome)
a lease is observed held by two runs at once, or a resume refetches the source
run still not COMPLETED after 12 operator invocations
any control, policy, registry or source-activation state changes during the run
